originalEntry.title: Showreel of advanced motion design techniques
originalEntry.author: lukasersil
originalEntry.description: A 15-second motion showreel covering kinetic type, 3D, fluid sims and particles, made at max effort; the post also shows a version using the author's brand kit.
originalEntry.description_zh: 15 秒动效作品集，涵盖动态文字、3D、流体模拟和粒子，max effort 生成；帖子里还有一版套用了作者的品牌素材。
originalEntry.prompt: Create a bold, dynamic 15-second motion graphics showreel that feels like the ultimate portfolio piece of an exceptionally talented motion designer. Showcase a wide range of advanced techniques: kinetic typography, smooth transitions, 2D and 3D animation, abstract geometry, fluid simulations, particles, distortion, creative masking, compositing, lighting, depth, and seamless camera movement. Keep the pacing fast, confident, and visually surprising, with every shot transitioning naturally into the next. Make it feel meticulously art-directed rather than like a random collection of effects. Push the creativity, polish, timing, and visual impact as far as possible. This should feel like the opening reel that gets a motion designer hired.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 制作一段大胆、动感的 15 秒动态图形作品集，让人感觉这是一位极其出色的动效设计师的终极代表作。展示多种高阶技法：动态文字排版、流畅转场、2D 与 3D 动画、抽象几何、流体模拟、粒子、扭曲变形、创意遮罩、合成、光照、景深，以及无缝的镜头运动。节奏要快、自信、视觉上出人意料，每个镜头都自然过渡到下一个。要让它看起来经过精心的美术指导，而不是一堆特效的随意拼凑。把创意、打磨、节奏把控和视觉冲击力推到极限。它应该像一支能让动效设计师拿到工作的开场作品集。
